decision: User requires new and existing conversations to default to GitHub TAKY-ASSETS storage for approved/reusable original images, separate UI layers, original Visual ID derivatives and asset manifests.
canonical_source_role: approved/reusable original and separately addressable source layers
consumer_role: pinned source manifest + verified derived PWA build copies, not second source authority
required_evidence: actual binary GitHub path and source revision
prohibitions: no screenshot crop as standalone layer
no unauthorized asset recreation or flattening
no global publication of private original photos
explicit_bootstrap: Latest TAKY asset rule TKY-ASSET-001: assets original and separate layers to TAKY-ASSETS; UI binds revisioned source and verifies real render.
